explanation: This query finds the file with the fewest lines of code (lightest weight) among those whose headings contain the word 'tent'. It joins the files table with the headings table on the file identifier and filters for headings that include 'tent'. The results are ordered by line count ascending, so the returned file has the smallest line count.
sql: SELECT f.file_id, f.line_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files AS f JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.headings AS h ON f.file_id = h.file_id WHERE h.value LIKE '%tent%' ORDER BY f.line_count ASC LIMIT 1;
